# CineRename

> CineRename is an automatic media file renamer and library organizer (Windows, macOS, Linux, NAS, Docker) that renames and organizes movies, TV shows (series), anime and subtitles for Plex, Jellyfin, Emby and Kodi libraries. Built in Rust as a fast, modern alternative to FileBot and tinyMediaManager, it processes your files entirely locally with zero upload, previews every change before touching a file, and keeps a one-click undo history. Free to try; Pro from €1/month (1 EUR), €5/year or €30 lifetime.

CineRename directly renames video and subtitle files on your local storage. It is a modern alternative to FileBot, tinyMediaManager, Sonarr/Radarr (for file renaming), Advanced Renamer and similar tools. Video files are processed locally and are never uploaded. Only titles, IDs, language choices or the OpenSubtitles file fingerprint are sent to the configured metadata and subtitle providers (TheTVDB, TVmaze, AniList, Kitsu, OpenSubtitles).

The site is available in English (default), French (/fr), Spanish (/es) and Simplified Chinese (/zh). A complete plain-text version of this information, including the FAQ and pricing details, is at https://cinerename.app/llms-full.txt

## Key facts
- Category: media file renamer and library organizer
- Platforms: Windows 10/11, macOS, Linux, NAS/Docker (headless CLI, WebUI/TUI)
- Built with Rust and Tauri (desktop), Svelte 5 (interface)
- Features: drag and drop (files, folders, ZIP/RAR/7z), before/after preview, Plex/Jellyfin/Emby/Kodi presets, anime absolute numbering, subtitle search with preview, multi-quality duplicate detection, automatic pipeline mode, watch folders, CLI and scheduler, history with one-click undo
- Pricing: free tier (2 renames and 2 subtitle searches per day); Pro €1/month, €5/year or €30 lifetime (taxes included); Pro license covers up to 20 concurrent devices
- Contact: cinerename@gmail.com · X: https://x.com/CineRename · GitHub: https://github.com/CineRename
